Model Storage and Data Management

Source: R/model_storage.R
model_storage.Rd

Functions for saving, loading, and managing multimod models on disk.

Key Functions

save_model()

Save complete model to disk with format options (csv/ipc/parquet)

load_model()

Load model from disk with optional lazy loading

get_data()

Retrieve data with automatic lazy loading from disk

update_parameter()

Low-level function to modify parameter data

update_mapping()

Low-level function to modify mapping data

Workflow

  1. Import or interpolate data into model (creates data.frames in parameters/mappings)

  2. Use update_parameter() to set/modify parameter values

  3. Use save_model() to persist model to disk

  4. Use load_model() to reload model later

  5. Use get_data() to access data (loads from disk if needed)

Storage Formats

  • csv - Universal, human-readable (default)

  • ipc - Arrow IPC/Feather (.arrow extension), fastest, compression: zstd level 15 (recommended)

  • parquet - Popular Arrow format (but may have compatibility issues)
